title: HappyCamper demo page
settled: The page uses Verdana on the distribution page green, with left-aligned text.
The intro is short, and one link points to the existing downloads page.
The app mock-up uses Lucida Grande and etched edges, with no gradients or blurred shadows.
Sidebar filters start collapsed and use caret indicators.
Filter examples use one-line camper rows with a notes panel beside them.
A compact previous, count, and next control switches examples.
Name, round, and short columns keep one width across examples.
A New since 2.3.0 section cycles one still frame per newer feature, each with one sentence.
Demo points are made through the rows chosen, using the app's real columns.
The main mock-up shows the app before 2.5, titled HappyCamper, without Help.
Column Visibility groups columns as Names, Core, Activities, Aquatic and Preferences, read top to bottom.
open: Check the page in Safari and Firefox.
Choose where the finished page will be hosted.
Swim Lessons sits partly off the right edge of the sample roster at 1360px.

iterations.name: v1 Guided tour
iterations.tried: A marketing-style page: slogan hero, guided tour, feature cards, score explainer, and a working app window.
iterations.why: It went well past the basic page that was asked for.

iterations.name: v2 Plain page
iterations.tried: Cut to an intro, the sample roster, and six filter breakdowns chosen with dropdowns. Verdana on green.
iterations.why: The direction held, but the intro was too long and the mock-up was over-shaded.

iterations.name: UI drafts
iterations.tried: A comparison sheet of four edge treatments beside a real render of the Java app: hard bevel, etched frame, solid ledge, flat ruled.
iterations.why: Draft B, the etched frame, was chosen.

iterations.name: v3 Etched UI
iterations.tried: Applied the etched frame and the new intro. Filters start collapsed with caret indicators.
iterations.why: The styling held. The centered intro did not.

iterations.name: v4 Pass/fail
iterations.tried: Left-aligned intro. Each filter shows a passing card beside a failing card, with no pickers.
iterations.why: Curated cases worked, but the lists had no headers.

iterations.name: v5 Grouped
iterations.tried: Examples became small app-style tables, with rows grouped under filter-option bands.
iterations.why: The table format worked, but the bands read as confusing extra rows.

iterations.name: v6 Side notes
iterations.tried: A Notes column spans each group of rows, with worded previous and next controls and numbered pages.
iterations.why: Notes added the value, but they stretched rows and the controls were wordy.
contributed: controls that read as switching examples

iterations.name: v7a Row notes
iterations.tried: One short note per camper in a column beside the table.
iterations.why: Keeps the tightest link to each row, but was not chosen.

iterations.name: v7b Panel
iterations.tried: Notes sit in a panel left of the table, and rows stay on one line.
iterations.why: Chosen from the three drafts and carried into v8.

iterations.name: v7c Footer
iterations.tried: One note line per filter option under the table.
iterations.why: The most compact option, but was not chosen.

iterations.name: v8 Final
iterations.tried: The notes panel with camper rows for Programs, consistent column widths, a fitted frame, and no example status lines.
iterations.why: Carried into v9 as the base for the new-features section.

revisions.ask: now update v8 to show an 'overqualified' swimmer - a blue level swimmer in swim lessons is flagged as an error
revisions.changed: Swim Lessons now includes Theo, a Blue swimmer assigned Swimming and flagged as Assigned lessons.

iterations.name: v9 New views
iterations.tried: Added a "New since 2.3.0" section that cycles one still frame from each newer feature.
iterations.why: The simple frames held, but they needed explanations and an honest demand frame.

iterations.name: v10 Explained views
iterations.tried: Each view got a one-line explanation. Sort by demand uses demo campers who ranked Climbing from first to not at all.
contributed: demand shown through the rows chosen

revisions.ask: fix 10. The selections are innacurate and ugly, swim column preset doesnt even show the important swim fields.
revisions.changed: Removed cell highlights, showed the swim fields in the preset view, and switched the demand activity to Climbing.

revisions.ask: I instructed you to order preferences the activity in an way that Demonstrates the progression of demand
revisions.changed: Replaced the rows with five demo campers ranking Climbing 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 6th and not at all, in the real Activity Preferences column.

iterations.name: v11 Older mock-up
iterations.tried: Trimmed the main window to controls from before 2.5, titled it HappyCamper, and removed Help.
iterations.why: Kept as the mock-up base for v12.
ruled_out: a version number in the window title

revisions.ask: A is the win. make the change but keep it as v11. also remove 'help' as it offers nothing for the demo.
revisions.changed: Window title became HappyCamper and the Help button was removed.

iterations.name: v12 Final
iterations.tried: Grouped Column Visibility dialog, new default columns, matched column widths, an overqualified swimmer, and a short description.
iterations.why: The page shared with the audience.
